jobs.title: Services Project-Program Management Consultant
jobs.description:
Services Project-Program Management Consultant

Dell Technologies Professional Services is seeking a Consultant on our Professional Services team in Kazakhstan, to lead and govern our most complex, high-stakes deployment programs - including large-scale GPU and network rack installations across enterprise data center environments. This is a senior advisory role that demands strategic thinking, seasoned judgment, and the ability to operate as the definitive value orchestrator across multi-project portfolios, on-site within customer data centers. You will set the standard for ensuring that what was sold is precisely what is realized, applying predictive risk intelligence and an AI-forward delivery philosophy to protect outcomes and accelerate customer success.

What You'll Achieve
You will define and elevate the practice of deployment project and program management within Dell Technologies, leading strategic engagements that directly influence customer confidence, contract renewal, and long-term partnership growth. From governing multi-workstream execution and shift-level operations to resolving complex onsite escalations across engineering, construction, networking, and operations teams, you will shape how our customers experience the full power of their Dell Technologies investment - and mentor the next generation of consultants to do the same.

You will:
- Lead and govern complex, multi-workstream deployment programs - including GPU, network, and large-scale compute rack installations - travelling regularly to customer data center sites to provide executive-level oversight, manage daily execution, resolve escalations, and ensure uncompromising delivery quality.
- Operate as the senior value orchestrator and trusted strategic advisor  to customer leadership, ensuring end-to-end alignment between the contracted solution and realized business outcomes while serving as the senior onsite point of contact for deployment status, risk, and cross-functional issue resolution.
- Architect and institutionalize predictive risk frameworks that surface early warning signals - resource constraints, schedule drift, vendor coordination gaps, construction readiness delays, and logistics blockers - and drive pre-emptive intervention strategies that protect both the customer and Dell Technologies.
- Identify and champion lifecycle value and expansion opportunities  across the portfolio, partnering with sales, pre-sales, and customer success teams to translate delivery insights and shift-level reporting into actionable growth strategies and deeper customer relationships.
- Champion adaptability, AI-driven delivery innovation, and continuous improvement,  mentoring and onboarding junior consultants and onsite resources while embedding emerging tools and methodologies that future-proof deployment operations and raise the performance bar across the practice.

Essential Requirements:
- 12–15 years of progressive experience in project and program management within technology services, IT infrastructure deployment, or data center operations, including significant leadership of complex, customer-facing programs with multi-million-dollar scope.
- Outstanding executive communication, negotiation, and stakeholder influence skills, with a demonstrated ability to coordinate across engineering, construction, networking, and operations teams and to operate as a credible strategic advisor to C-level customer sponsors and senior internal leadership.
- Proven expertise in governing concurrent, multi-workstream deployment portfolios with rigorous scope, schedule, financial, and risk management - including real-time issue resolution, daily and shift-level reporting, and experience recovering distressed programs.
- Willingness and ability to travel to customer data center sites in US, including extended onsite rotational periods, and to adapt seamlessly to dynamic, fast-changing environments.
- Demonstrated ability to apply formal problem-solving and issue-resolution methodologies to maintain project momentum, particularly during the real-time troubleshooting and escalation scenarios common in large-scale deployments. PMP or Prince2 Practitioner certification

Desirable Requirements:
- Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project and related scheduling platforms. These roles will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and adjusting complex, multi-workstream deployment plans throughout the project lifecycle.
- A genuine enthusiasm for AI, automation, and emerging technologies - particularly experience with AI data center networking technologies and high-performance fabrics such as InfiniBand, NVIDIA NVLink, and 400G/800G Ethernet. While detailed design and implementation expertise is not required, an understanding of these technologies supports more effective installation sequencing, cross-functional coordination, risk identification, and escalation management.
- Strong technical acumen that enables effective engagement with architects, engineers, vendors, and deployment teams. While these roles are not expected to perform technical design or implementation work, technical fluency helps build credibility, facilitates informed decision making, and allows the PM to challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and drive discussions toward resolution rather than simply serving as an intermediary.

jobs.title: Consultant, Project and Program Management
jobs.description:
SUMMARY
This role serves as the voice of the customer within the Quality Management team, independently evaluating end-to-end customer journeys, identifying experience gaps and usability issues, and driving improvements across the digital support ecosystem. Through structured journey assessments, customer-first reviews, and cross-functional engagement, this role ensures Dell's digital experiences consistently meet customer expectations and quality standards.
ACCOUNTABILITIES
- Conduct recurring end-to-end reviews of customer journeys across digital support channels, self-service experiences, and customer-facing portals.
- Act as an independent customer advocate by evaluating experiences through the lens of customer effort, ease of use, and usability.
- Perform structured mystery shopper assessments to validate customer experiences and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Identify customer friction points, process breakdowns, usability issues, and gaps impacting customer success.
- Document findings, quantify customer impact, and communicate actionable recommendations to business stakeholders.
- Partner with Product Management, Engineering, UX, Support Operations, and Digital Channel teams to drive remediation and experience improvements.
- Track identified issues through the Quality Management process and ensure actions are progressed through to implementation and validation.
- Collaborate with Quality, Sentiment, VOC, and Analytics teams to correlate experience issues with customer feedback, adoption metrics, operational performance, and business outcomes.
- Develop journey health scorecards, dashboards, and executive-ready reporting highlighting customer experience risks and opportunities.
- Validate new releases, enhancements, and strategic initiatives from a customer perspective before and after deployment.
- Facilitate stakeholder reviews to build alignment on experience improvements and drive accountability for execution.
- Measure the effectiveness of implemented changes and continuously monitor customer journey health across critical experiences.
- Recommend opportunities to simplify customer interactions, reduce effort, improve satisfaction, and increase digital channel adoption.

Essential Requirements:
- 10+ years of experience in customer experience, digital transformation, quality management, program management, UX evaluation, customer journey analysis, or related disciplines.
- Demonstrated experience evaluating customer journeys, identifying experience gaps, and driving improvements across digital products or customer-facing platforms.
- Strong understanding of customer-centric design principles, usability evaluation, and customer effort reduction.
- Experience conducting customer journey mapping, journey assessments, usability reviews, or mystery shopper programs.
- Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive change in complex matrixed environments without direct authority.
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform observations into actionable business recommendations.
- Experience leading improvement initiatives from identification through implementation and validation.
- Strong executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience using customer experience, operational, and behavioural data to support recommendations and prioritization decisions.

Desirable Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree.
- Experience supporting digital support, self-service, eCommerce, customer service, or customer success environments.
- Familiarity with Voice of Customer (VOC), CSAT, NPS, sentiment analysis, and customer feedback programs.
- Experience working alongside UX, Product Management, Engineering, or Digital Transformation teams.
- Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), continuous improvement methodologies, Lean, Six Sigma, or root cause analysis techniques.
- Experience supporting AI-powered, omnichannel, or digital-first customer experiences.

Compensation
Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is USD $146,200 - USD $189,200

Benefits and Perks of working at Dell Technologies
Your life. Your health. Supported by your benefits. You can explore the overall benefits experience that awaits you as a Dell Technologies team member — right now at MyWellatDell.com

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de projet - Gestionnaire de programme sénior - Senior Project - Program Manager
jobs.description:
Gestionnaire de projet / Gestionnaire de programme sénior
Description du poste
Nous recherchons un gestionnaire de projet expérimenté(e) qui jouera un rôle clé dans la concrétisation des engagements pris envers nos clients. À titre de responsable de la livraison, vous veillerez à transformer les objectifs définis lors de la vente en résultats tangibles, en assurant une exécution rigoureuse et une expérience client exemplaire.
Dans ce rôle stratégique à forte visibilité, vous dirigerez des projets de déploiement de bout en bout, incluant l'installation à grande échelle d'infrastructures GPU, de calcul et de réseautique au sein des centres de données de nos clients. Vous serez responsable de la livraison des solutions dans le respect des échéanciers, des budgets et des engagements contractuels.
À l'intersection de l'exécution opérationnelle et du conseil stratégique, vous mettrez à profit votre expertise en gestion des risques, votre capacité d'anticipation et votre intérêt pour les technologies émergentes afin de maximiser la valeur générée pour nos clients.
Ce que vous réaliserez
Au-delà des responsabilités traditionnelles de gestion de projet, vous agirez comme un partenaire stratégique de confiance pour nos clients. Votre contribution ne se limitera pas au suivi des échéanciers ou des jalons du projet; vous contribuerez activement à renforcer la confiance des parties prenantes, à anticiper et atténuer les risques avant qu'ils n'affectent la livraison et à identifier des occasions de création de valeur tout au long du cycle de vie de l'engagement.
De la planification des activités quotidiennes à la coordination des équipes sur le terrain, en passant par la résolution d'enjeux opérationnels en temps réel, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant pour assurer la réussite des déploiements et faire en sorte que les résultats obtenus répondent pleinement aux attentes du client.
Votre leadership contribuera directement à renforcer la réputation de Dell Technologies comme partenaire de confiance reconnu pour sa capacité à livrer des résultats concrets.
Responsabilités
Vous devrez :
• Effectuer des déplacements réguliers dans les centres de données des clients afin de diriger les activités de déploiement, notamment l'installation à grande échelle de racks GPU, de solutions de calcul et d'infrastructures réseau, tout en assurant la coordination des différentes parties prenantes et le suivi étroit des activités sur le terrain.
• Agir comme principal point de contact auprès du client pour toutes les questions liées à l'avancement du projet, à la gestion des risques, aux escalades et à la résolution des enjeux associés à la logistique, aux installations et à la préparation des sites.
• Veiller à ce que les engagements contractuels se traduisent par des résultats concrets et mesurables pour le client.
• Identifier de façon proactive les risques susceptibles d'affecter le projet, notamment les retards d'échéancier, les contraintes de ressources, les dépendances fournisseurs ou les enjeux liés à l'état de préparation des sites, puis coordonner les actions nécessaires pour en limiter l'impact.
• Adopter une approche-conseil auprès du client afin de maximiser la valeur générée par les solutions mises en œuvre et de repérer les occasions permettant de soutenir ses objectifs d'affaires à long terme.
• Produire des rapports clairs, précis et réguliers à l'intention de la direction du programme et des principales parties prenantes.
• Favoriser l'adoption de nouvelles approches, technologies et solutions propulsées par l'intelligence artificielle afin d'améliorer continuellement l'efficacité des processus de livraison, la qualité de l'information et la collaboration entre les équipes impliquées dans des déploiements complexes.
Qualifications requises
• De 10 à 12 années d'expérience en gestion de projets ou de programmes dans le domaine des technologies, du déploiement d'infrastructures informatiques ou des opérations de centres de données, incluant la réalisation de projets complexes destinés à une clientèle d'entreprise.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, en coordination et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d'exercer un leadership crédible auprès des équipes techniques, des fournisseurs, des entrepreneurs, des clients et de la direction.
• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion simultanée de plusieurs volets de déploiement, tout en maintenant l'équilibre entre la portée, les échéanciers, les coûts et la qualité.
• Disponibilité pour voyager fréquemment à travers le Canada (environ 50 % du temps) et travailler sur les sites clients pendant des périodes prolongées lorsque les projets l'exigent.
• Solide capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes et à gérer efficacement les incidents et les situations d'escalade dans des environnements à haut niveau d'exigence opérationnelle.
Atouts recherchés
• Maîtrise de Microsoft Project ainsi que des outils de planification et de gestion de projet connexes.
• Intérêt marqué pour l'intelligence artificielle, l'automatisation et les technologies émergentes, particulièrement les environnements de centres de données optimisés pour l'IA ainsi que les technologies telles qu'InfiniBand, NVIDIA NVLink et Ethernet 400G/800G.
• Solide compréhension des environnements techniques permettant d'interagir efficacement avec les architectes, les ingénieurs, les fournisseurs et les équipes de déploiement. Sans être responsable de la conception ou de l'implantation technique, vous devez être en mesure de comprendre les enjeux, de remettre en question certaines hypothèses et de faciliter la prise de décisions éclairées.
• Capacité à lire et interpréter avec précision les plans et documents de construction.
• Connaissance des normes OSHA ou volonté d'obtenir la certification OSHA 30.
Renseignements complémentaires
Ce rôle exige une grande capacité d'adaptation afin de répondre aux exigences des différentes phases de déploiement et aux horaires variables qui y sont associés. Les personnes candidates doivent être à l'aise dans des environnements complexes et à rythme soutenu, où la prise de décision sur le terrain joue un rôle déterminant dans la réussite des projets.

Senior Project / Program Manager
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager, where you will serve as the critical bridge between what was sold and what is realized for our customers. In this high-impact role, you will orchestrate end-to-end deployment projects — including large-scale GPU and network rack installations — on-site within customer data center environments, ensuring every solution lands on time, on budget, and fully aligned to contracted outcomes. You will operate at the intersection of hands-on delivery excellence and strategic advisory, leveraging predictive risk insights and an AI-forward mindset to drive measurable customer value.
What You'll Achieve
You will evolve beyond traditional project management into the role of a trusted value orchestrator — someone who doesn't just track milestones but actively shapes customer confidence, mitigates risk before it materializes, and identifies lifecycle value and expansion opportunities throughout every engagement. From managing daily workflows and shift-level task sequencing to resolving real-time onsite challenges, your work will directly ensure that the promise made during the sale becomes the reality experienced by the customer, reinforcing Dell Technologies' reputation as an outcomes-driven partner.
You will:
- Travel regularly to customer data center sites to lead deployment activities  — including GPU, network, and large-scale compute rack installations — coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and maintaining hands-on visibility into daily workflows, shift activities, and site readiness.
- Serve as the customer's trusted advisor and value orchestrator , translating contracted scope into realized outcomes while acting as the primary onsite point of contact for deployment status, risk escalation, and issue resolution across logistics, installation, and construction readiness.
- Deploy predictive risk insights to identify early warning signals —  such as schedule slippage, resource gaps, vendor delays, or site-readiness blockers — and intervene proactively to protect delivery timelines and customer confidence.
- Drive lifecycle value and expansion opportunities  by maintaining a consultative lens throughout the engagement, providing clear daily and shift-level reporting to program leadership, and surfacing areas where additional Dell Technologies solutions can accelerate the customer's business objectives.
- Embrace change, emerging technologies, and AI-driven tools  to continuously improve delivery methodologies, reporting accuracy, and stakeholder coordination across complex, multi-workstream data center deployments.

Essential Requirements:
- 10–12 years of experience in project or program management within technology services, IT infrastructure deployment, or data center operations, with a proven track record of delivering complex, customer-facing deployment projects.
- Exceptional communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate as a credible onsite lead and advisor to technical teams, vendors, contractors, customer executives, and internal leadership simultaneously.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent deployment workstreams, balancing scope, schedule, cost, and quality — including daily task tracking, issue troubleshooting, and transparent reporting to program leadership.
- Willingness and ability to travel frequently (~50%) to customer data center sites across the Canada, including extended onsite rotational periods as project demands require.
- Demonstrated ability to apply formal problem-solving and issue-resolution methodologies to maintain project momentum, particularly during the real-time troubleshooting and escalation scenarios common in large-scale deployments.

Desirable Requirements:
- Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project and related scheduling platforms. These roles will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and adjusting complex, multi-workstream deployment plans throughout the project lifecycle.
- A genuine enthusiasm for AI, automation, and emerging technologies — particularly experience with AI data center networking technologies and high-performance fabrics such as InfiniBand, NVIDIA NVLink, and 400G/800G Ethernet. While detailed design and implementation expertise is not required, an understanding of these technologies supports more effective installation sequencing, cross-functional coordination, risk identification, and escalation management.
- Strong technical acumen that enables effective engagement with architects, engineers, vendors, and deployment teams. While these roles are not expected to perform technical design or implementation work, technical fluency helps build credibility, facilitates informed decision making, and allows the PM to challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and drive discussions toward resolution rather than simply serving as an intermediary.
- Ability to accurately read and understand construction documents/plans.
- Familiarity with OSHA standards, or a willingness to obtain OSHA 30 certification. Experience operation in multi-employer, multi-vendor construction or data center environments where safety responsibilities are shared across multiple parties.

Additional Notes
This role requires flexibility to support varying schedules and deployment phases. Candidates must be comfortable working in dynamic, high-pressure environments where onsite decision-making is critical.
Compensation
Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $132,800 to $ 182,600.
Dell Canada Inc. (“Dell”) is committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve, and creating an environment where every employee has the opportunity to reach her/his potential. We welcome applications from: women, Aboriginal persons, persons with disabilities, ethnic minorities, visible minorities, and others who may contribute to diversification. As part of our commitment to accessibility for all persons with disabilities, Dell will, upon the request of the applicant, provide accommodation during the recruitment process to ensure equal access to applicants with disabilities. If you are selected for an interview and you need accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent deployment workstreams, balancing scope, schedule, cost, and quality, including daily task tracking, issue troubleshooting, and transparent reporting to program leadership.

- Demonstrated ability to apply formal problem-solving and issue-resolution methodologies to maintain project momentum, particularly during the real-time troubleshooting and escalation scenarios common in large-scale deployments.

Desirable Requirements:

Analyst, Project|Program Management

Everything in Dell Technologies is groundbreaking, from the designers of our products to the developers of our supply systems. Our Supply Chain team within Materials and Purchasing drives the development, implementation and management of supply chain operations and suppliers in the delivery of strategic programs. It’s all about managing supplier relationships and ensuring the availability of parts and services in the supply chain, while maintaining inventory at acceptable levels. We focus our resources on the continuous improvement of the movement of materials through production processes and establishing key performance metrics and benchmarks relating to supply chain planning and forecasting.

Join us as a member of   Supply Chain Immersion Program (SCIP)   on our   Supply Chain team   in   Singapore   to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact.
Take the first step towards your dream career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

- Bachelor and above degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or applicable field with graduation between 2026/7/1-2027/6/28

- Fluent English communication
